consumer: The pickup over-encumbrance branch that, when an item exceeds carry capacity, raises the wear/wield/skip choice and asks the player which to do through the real input loop.
scope: An interactive prompt/menu answered through the engine's real active input loop, offering and consuming the player's wear/wield/skip selection at the too-heavy pickup site.
decisive_source: src/character.cpp::Character::weight_capacity computes a raw mass number from base capacity, strength, mutations, enchantments, worn items, and bionics; it is a re-derived scalar, not the engine's too-heavy decision nor the menu that resolves it.
divergence: An item whose weight sits exactly at or just over capacity: weight_capacity returns only a number and never surfaces the wear/wield/skip menu, so a player who would have chosen 'wield' to carry it instead gets no choice and the item is silently skipped or mis-handled.
